prompt_version: s5-extract-facts-v2 (adapted from Paleo Atlas extract-facts-v3; v2 after Sofía's S5 review)

facts.statement: The study introduces a new electronic device designed to deliver electrical stimulation to nerves through 16 separate channels at the same time.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: The device uses a capacitor to monitor the amount of electrical charge sent to each channel and an inductor to save energy during the stimulation process.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: The stimulator reached a maximum energy efficiency of 88%, with performance variation staying under 4.1% across a range of tissue resistances and charge levels.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: When two channels were stimulated at the same time, the difference in delivered charge between them was less than 0.98%.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: Among the stimulators compared in the study, this design had the smallest estimated physical size for devices with 16 or more channels.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: The device was tested in living subjects to show that it could successfully stimulate multiple channels at once.
facts.subject: animals
